title: Public Alert No.44/2025 – Recall of Mivacron Injection 0.2%, Nimbex Injection 2mg/ml Over Safety Concerns
summary: NAFDAC relays Hong Kong recall of one batch of Mivacron Injection 0.2% (mivacurium) and five batches of Nimbex Injection 2mg/mL (cisatracurium) by Aspen Pharmacare Asia Limited, after manual visual inspection deficiencies meant glass particles in ampoules may not have been detect
